name: Kekkai ~Aru Rinshou Shinrishi no Kiroku Yori~
original_name: 結界～ある臨床心理士の記録より～
source:
Kyoko was found at the scene of a brutal murder by chief inspector Kaoru. Due to the shock of the incident, Kyoko has lost her memory. Kaoru has asked Junichi, a suave psychiatrist, to help cure Kyoko, only to find out that she has multiple personalites.

[From [url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=9314]ANN[/url]]
translation:
恭子在残酷谋杀案现场被警视正薰发现。由于受到事件冲击，恭子失去了记忆。薰请圆滑的精神科医生纯一帮助治愈恭子，却发现她拥有多重人格。

[译自[url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=9314]ANN[/url]]
